title: 空心变压器的反映阻抗
statement: 空心变压器：V̇_s = 150∠0° V（有效值），ω = 100 rad/s。原边电阻 R_1 = 3 Ω，L_1 = 0.2 H，L_2 = 0.08 H，M = 0.1 H。副边接负载 R_L = 6 Ω。
用原边等效电路（反映阻抗）求从 a 端看进去的输入阻抗 Z_in = R_in + jX_in（不含 V_s），以及负载功率 P_L。

questions.ask: 输入电阻 R_in = Re Z_in = ?
输入电抗 X_in = Im Z_in = ?
questions.explain: X_in = ωL_1 + Im Z_ref = 20 − 8 = 12 Ω：副边的感性阻抗反映到原边变成了容性（−j8），使原边的电抗减小。

questions.ask: 副边回路 Z_22 = 6 + j8 Ω 是感性的，它在原边的反映阻抗是：
choiceExplain: 反映阻抗 (ωM)²/Z_22 与 Z_22 的共轭成比例：电阻部分同号，电抗部分变号，不会保持副边原来的性质。
只有 Z_22 是纯电阻（例如副边调到谐振）时反映阻抗才是纯电阻；这里 Z_22 = 6 + j8 Ω 含有电抗，反映阻抗的电抗也不为零。
questions.explain: Z_ref = (ωM)²/Z_22 = (ωM)²·Z_22*/|Z_22|²，与 Z_22 共轭成比例：电阻部分同号，电抗部分变号。感性的副边反映为容性。

hints: 原边等效电路：Z_in = Z_11 + (ωM)²/Z_22，其中 Z_11 = R_1 + jωL_1，Z_22 = R_L + jωL_2。
反映阻抗的电阻部分吸收的功率，就是副边实际消耗的功率。

en.title: Reflected impedance of an air-core transformer
statement: Air-core transformer: V̇_s = 150∠0° V (rms), ω = 100 rad/s. Primary resistance R_1 = 3 Ω, L_1 = 0.2 H, L_2 = 0.08 H, M = 0.1 H. The secondary feeds a load R_L = 6 Ω.
Using the primary equivalent circuit (reflected impedance), find the input impedance Z_in = R_in + jX_in seen at terminal a (without V_s), and the load power P_L.

questions.explain: Z_22 = R_L + jωL_2 = 6 + j8 Ω, reflected impedance Z_ref = (ωM)²/Z_22 = 100/(6 + j8) = 6 − j8 Ω. Z_in = R_1 + jωL_1 + Z_ref = 3 + j20 + 6 − j8 = 9 + j12 Ω, so R_in = 9 Ω.
X_in = ωL_1 + Im Z_ref = 20 − 8 = 12 Ω: the inductive secondary is reflected as a capacitive term (−j8), which reduces the primary reactance.
I_1 = 150 / |9 + j12| = 150 / 15 = 10 A. The load power is the power absorbed by the reflected resistance: P_L = I_1² × Re Z_ref = 100 × 6 = 600 W. Check: I_2 = ωM·I_1/|Z_22| = 10 A, P_L = I_2²·R_L.

questions.ask: The secondary loop Z_22 = 6 + j8 Ω is inductive. Its reflected impedance in the primary is…
choiceExplain: The reflected impedance (ωM)²/Z_22 is proportional to the conjugate of Z_22: the resistance keeps its sign but the reactance flips, so it does not keep the secondary's character.
It is purely resistive only when Z_22 is (e.g. a secondary tuned to resonance); here Z_22 = 6 + j8 Ω has a reactance, so the reflected impedance has a nonzero reactance too.
questions.explain: Z_ref = (ωM)²/Z_22 = (ωM)²·Z_22*/|Z_22|² is proportional to the conjugate of Z_22: the resistance keeps its sign and the reactance flips. An inductive secondary reflects as a capacitive impedance.

hints: Primary equivalent circuit: Z_in = Z_11 + (ωM)²/Z_22 with Z_11 = R_1 + jωL_1 and Z_22 = R_L + jωL_2.
The power absorbed by the resistive part of the reflected impedance is exactly the power consumed in the secondary.
solution: **2. Reflected impedance.** Z_ref = (ωM)²/Z_22 = 100/(6 + j8) = 6 − j8 Ω.
**3. Input impedance.** Z_in = Z_11 + Z_ref = **9 + j12 Ω** = 15∠53.13° Ω (R_in = 9 Ω, X_in = 12 Ω).
**4. Primary and secondary currents.** İ_1 = 150/Z_in = 10∠−53.13° A. The secondary equation (R_L + jωL_2)İ_2 = jωM·İ_1 (İ_2 as drawn) gives I_2 = ωM·I_1/|Z_22| = 10 × 10/10 = 10 A.
**5. Power.** P_L = I_2²·R_L = **600 W** = I_1²·Re Z_ref ✓. R_1 dissipates 300 W, and the source delivers P = 150 × 10 × cos 53.13° = 900 W = 300 + 600 ✓.
